Hello, all my favorite Beta Readers. I wanted to let you know that I am offering the following, limited time deal to EVERYONE, so add a copy of The Ripper’s Son to your libraries if you haven’t already gotten it and spread the word. Here is the entire deal notification with link:
LABOR DAY THRILLER DEAL: The Ripper’s Son FREE Aug 31 – Sep 4 on Amazon!
A perfect world. A lethal secret. One man will light the fuse.

In The Ripper’s Son, bestselling author Richard Phillips launches a relentless sci-fi thriller that rips through the illusion of utopia. The world’s AI overlords have ended war, disease, and death. But peace has a price… one Rob Gregory never agreed to pay. Gifted with a unique ability, Rob lives quietly in Tuscany with his wife… until a devastating “accident” reignites his assassin’s bloodline. From Italy’s sun-drenched coast to its digital underworld, Rob unleashes hell on the forces that tore his life apart… splintered AIs, corrupt power brokers, and a cartel trafficking in forbidden human weakness.
The hunt is on. The fuse is lit.
Get The Ripper’s Son FREE on Amazon now

Enjoy and have a wonderful Labor Day.

Richard
